story.iWant: record income transactions with detailed source tracking
story.soThat: I can maintain an accurate and auditable financial record of all village revenue

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Database Schema: finance_transactions and funding_sources collections are created in Appwrite with all required attributes and indexes using the latest TablesDB API patterns.
Module Infrastructure: Finance module structure is initialized at src/modules/finance with proper routing and state management setup.

Income Recording UI: Users can access a "Record Transaction" dialog from the Finance Transactions list. The form includes: Amount, Category, Source Module, Funding Source, Date, Description, and Payment Method.
Validation & Logic: System validates that amount is positive and required fields are present. "Income" is set as the transaction type automatically.
RBAC Enforcement: Only users with finance:write permission (Finance Manager, Admin) can see the "Record Income" button and submit transactions.
Navigation: "Finance" item appears in the main navigation menu for authorized users only.

constraints.constraint: Must use Appwrite TablesDB API for schema definitions.
Must use Quasar components and grid system for responsive design.
TransactionForm must be a dialog component, maximized on mobile.

interfaces.interface: Collection: finance_transactions (id, type, amount, category, source_module, funding_source_id, date, description, status)
Collection: funding_sources (id, name, total_allocated, current_balance, restrictions)

tests.standards: Refer to docs/testing.md for detailed test cases.

ideas.idea: Unit: Test finance-store actions for API success/failure handling.
Component: Test TransactionForm validation (required fields, positive amount).
Integration: Verify "Record Income" button visibility based on permissions.
E2E: Complete flow of recording an income transaction and verifying it appears in the list.
